sources.title: Ecuador Ministry of Tourism: Cuyabeno
facts: Cuyabeno includes seasonally flooded forest, rivers and lagoons including Laguna Grande.
A common approach uses Lago Agrio, the road toward Tarapoa and a Cuyabeno River entry, then canoe travel.
River transfer duration depends on water level.
Activities include guided forest walks, night excursions, birding and canoe or kayak exploration.

sources.title: Ecuador Ministry of Tourism: visiting Cuyabeno
facts: The ministry recommends registered operators and licensed guides.
Community experiences should be arranged with local hosts.
Birds, caimans and river dolphins occur; this is habitat context, not a sighting promise.
